title: Replace home 'Shop by Style' row with 'Explore by Style' curved-badge carousel (5 categories) and category navigation

requirements.text: Replace the current home-top "Shop by Style" block with a new top-of-home section that matches the final spec: a centered heading "Explore by Style" (serif, gold accent) followed by a horizontally scrollable carousel row of 5 curved badges (25px radius) in the existing dark luxury theme.

quotes:
On home page top:
  - Heading: "Explore by Style" (centered, serif font, gold accent)
  - Horizontal scrollable carousel of curved badges (25px radius, pearl blue bg, gold border glow on hover)
  - Only 5 categories with impressive names: ...

acceptanceCriteria: Home page (path "/") renders a top section above the existing CinematicHeroSlider.
Heading text is exactly "Explore by Style" and is visually centered, serif-styled, and uses the gold accent (#D4AF37).
A single-row, horizontally scrollable carousel of badges is present with no layout overflow/breakage on desktop or mobile.

requirements.text: Implement the 5 carousel badges exactly with these mappings and visuals: Banarasi → "Zari Royalty"; Organza → "Sheer Elegance"; Georgette → "Flowing Grace"; Silk → "Silk Symphony"; Kalamkari → "Heritage Artistry". Each badge must include a small circular image/icon at the left plus the impressive-name text.

quotes:
Only 5 categories with impressive names:
    - Banarasi → "Zari Royalty"
    - Organza → "Sheer Elegance"
    - Georgette → "Flowing Grace"
    - Silk → "Silk Symphony"
    - Kalamkari → "Heritage Artistry"
  - Each badge: small circular image/icon + name text

acceptanceCriteria: Exactly 5 badges are shown (no Sequin, no Ready To Wear).
Each badge shows (1) a circular icon/image and (2) the exact impressive label text from the spec.
Badges use curved corners (25px radius) and a pearl blue background (#7FB3D5) consistent with the dark luxury theme.

requirements.text: Add hover interactions for each badge: on hover, show a gold glow/border effect and a subtle lift/scale animation to 1.05. Keep interactions lightweight and consistent with reduced-motion preferences where applicable.
acceptanceCriteria: Hovering a badge visibly adds a gold glow/border highlight and scales the badge to ~1.05 without jarring motion.
Hover behavior does not introduce heavy particle effects or complex animations.
The hover effect does not interfere with scrolling/swiping the carousel on mobile.

requirements.text: Make each badge clickable and navigate via SPA navigation to a category collection destination without blank screens. Implement a safe, real route pattern for category collections (for example a dedicated path like "/collections?style=<slug>" or "/collections/<slug>") and ensure the destination renders meaningful storefront content (not an empty/blank page).

quotes: Click badge → open that category collection page

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking each badge changes the URL (SPA navigation) to a category-specific destination and does not reload the page.
The destination page renders correctly (no blank screen), and the user can navigate back to home normally.
The category destination is implemented for all 5 categories using a consistent slug scheme (e.g., banarasi/organza/georgette/silk/kalamkari).

requirements.text: Ensure the new "Explore by Style" carousel is mobile-responsive with swipeable horizontal scrolling and does not break layout in small viewports. The design must preserve the existing dark luxury theme and palette (black background, pearl blue #7FB3D5, gold #D4AF37).

quotes: Keep dark luxury theme (black bg, pearl blue #7FB3D5, gold #D4AF37)

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile, the badge row can be swiped horizontally (native overflow scrolling) and remains a single row without wrapping into broken layouts.
On desktop, the badge row is horizontally scrollable and visually aligned/centered within the existing page container constraints.
Colors match the provided palette and do not alter global theme tokens unexpectedly.

requirements.text: Generate and add 5 small circular category icon images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the carousel badges (no backend image serving).

quotes: Each badge: small circular image/icon + name text

acceptanceCriteria: Five icon images exist in frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly via static paths.
Each of the 5 badges displays its corresponding icon image cropped/masked to a circle.
No new backend endpoints or canister calls are introduced to serve these images.

requirements.text: Scope guardrails: do not change dashboard, profile, login flows, or add heavy visual effects; only implement the specified home-top redesign section and its navigation destinations, while keeping the existing overall layout and preventing regressions/blank screens.

quotes: No other changes (no dashboard mix, no heavy particles)

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard route (/dashboard) behavior and UI remain unchanged.
Login page and OTP verification flow remain functional and still land on "/" after success unless a return path is set.
No new particle systems or heavy background effects are added specifically for this section.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be modified: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Respect existing SPA navigation approach (useSpaLocation) and avoid introducing new routing frameworks.
Use English for all user-facing text in the implemented UI.
nonGoals: Do not add Sequin or Ready To Wear categories in this iteration.
Do not redesign the dashboard or auto-open the dashboard after login.
Do not add notification bells, real-time features, or heavy particle animations.
